purpose_context: This mission delivers GitHub Issue #150 by replacing the hardcoded cat purr used for petting and supercharged comfort audio with per-companion reaction sounds that follow the active roster character, surfaced in Settings > Audio and the Appearance character gallery, while preserving zero-idle-CPU audio engine power gating and all DND/call/mute suppression.
purpose_tldr: Give each roster companion (Bitz, Drako, Byte, Aero, Pixel, Volt) its own pet/comfort reaction sound instead of the universal cat purr
